name: Hartwell Home Group
address: 301 E Carmel Dr, Suite 200, Carmel, IN 46032
hoursText: Monday-Friday: 9am to 6pm, Saturday: 10am to 4pm, Sunday: by appointment only

profile.service_area: The Indianapolis metro: Marion, Hamilton, Boone and Johnson counties - including Indianapolis, Carmel, Fishers, Noblesville, Westfield, Zionsville, Greenwood and Speedway.
profile.brokerage: Hartwell Home Group is a team brokered by Crossroads Realty Partners. Lead agent Dana Hartwell is a licensed Indiana REALTOR; license details are available on request.
profile.buyer_services: Free buyer consultation (in person or video). Buyers sign a written buyer agreement before touring, as required since 2024; the agreement spells out how Dana is compensated, and in many cases the seller covers it - Dana goes over the details personally. A pre-approval letter or proof of funds is requested before a second showing, but not for the first.
profile.seller_services: Free, no-obligation home valuation and listing consultation. Every listing includes professional photography, a 3D virtual tour, a staging consultation, and MLS and major-site syndication. Commission is discussed at the listing consultation.
profile.showings: Showings need about 24 hours' notice; same-day is sometimes possible on vacant homes. Please bring a photo ID. Pending listings: we accept backup offers and can show pending homes to buyers who want to submit one. Coming-soon listings can't be shown until they go active. Video walkthroughs are available for out-of-town buyers.
profile.referrals: Lenders: Meridian Hills Mortgage (Tom Reyes, (317) 555-0171) and Lakeside Credit Union home loans. Real estate attorney: Bishop & Lowe Law, (317) 555-0183. Inspector: Keystone Home Inspections. Clients are free to use anyone they choose.
profile.policies: We work with residential buyers and sellers only - no rentals, property management or commercial. Dana's team includes a Spanish-speaking agent. Relocation clients welcome; video tours available.
